## demo-pspc-edge.csv (demonstration data)

Synthetic rows, not real buildings. All names are fake ("Demo Building N", "Demo Street"). They exercise: a score of 100, a non-ON row (QC), an empty score, a score of 101, a missing standard, and a duplicate upstream id.
